I5.quote: We demonstrate in-situ synthesis of homogeneously dispersed Ni-containing mesoporous carbon scaffold (Ni-MCS) for improving dehydrogenation kinetics of LiAlH4 (hereafter denoted as LAH).

notes: Primary research article on LiAlH4 impregnated into a mesoporous carbon scaffold (MCS) and Ni-MCS. All H2 data are desorption (dehydrogenation) of the hydride: TPD-MS (Fig. 7, Tonset and Tmax) and isothermal H2 desorbed (wt%) versus time at 150, 180 and 225 C (Figs. 8 and 9, y-axis 'H2 desorbed (wt%)'). The Methods name a Sieverts apparatus ('Suzuki Shokan PCT H2 Absorption Rig', main p. 3) but no absorption, rehydrogenation or gas-phase uptake value is reported anywhere; the reported 6.19 wt% is H2 released from LAH at 225 C in 120 min. The paper is not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF), is a primary research article, and does not state that its data were published before. Table 1 gives N2 BET areas (MCS 1559, Ni-MCS 699 m2/g), but these are not tied to any H2 uptake value.
